title: Job application automation with LLMs
summary: Collects job posts from several sources, screens each with one language model and confirms with another, with JSON answers and a check for claims not backed by the resume.

cover.alt: Cover of the job application automation project with language models

features: Collects job posts from several sources
Screening with one model and confirmation with another
JSON answers and a check for claims not backed by the resume
Prompt tuned with an evaluation set (train, validation and test)
Automatic model switch when the quota runs out
Scheduled runs and a WhatsApp bot that sends summaries and takes commands
